ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (4) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Рай» (rai, 'paradise') is kept distinct from «небо» (nebo, 'heaven'); «бог» (bog, 'God') is capitalized as everywhere, but God's pronouns stay lowercase as in the Russian. The attribution is printed as Tolstoy gives it: «Персидское (Аттар)» (Persidskoe (Attar), 'Persian (Attar)').
Source observation: [2] God's closing speech opens with « but has no closing », in the Russian («...близко ко мне.»); the English leaves the quotation unclosed accordingly.
